why: Multiple post-snapshot papers report improved exponent bounds on Δ_k(x) itself: Bellotti-Yang (2024) improved the bound for large fixed k, arXiv:2506.21823 (Jun 2025) gives explicit improved estimates on Δ_k(x), and a 2025 preprint reports better upper bounds for α_k for 9≤k≤20 improving on Trudgian-Yang.
queries: generalized Dirichlet divisor problem exponent improved 2025 arXiv
